disposition: DISCARDED IN FULL before any judgement was computed
cause: provider tokens-per-minute ceiling reached; pi's own auto-retry (3 attempts, 2s/4s/8s backoff) exhausted and the turn returned an assistant message with stopReason 'error', an errorMessage, no content block and an all-zero usage block
hold_condition_triggered: H2' (output_tokens == 0 AND errorMessage present AND content block absent - all three signals of the disjunction)
why_full_discard_and_not_partial: the preregistration marks H2' a full-redesign cause, not a partial-discard cause: a zero-usage turn leaves a user message with no assistant reply in the pi session, so every later turn of that unit is conditioned on a broken history and its cache accounting is unusable. Rather than reinterpret the criterion, the execution defect was fixed and leg B was re-run from scratch.
remedy_applied: a global sliding-window tokens-per-minute pacer in the runner (--tpm), set below the observed provider ceiling
fail-fast: a turn with stopReason 'error', an errorMessage or a zero-usage call aborts its unit immediately and writes no unit file
a retried unit is fully re-materialized and its pi session store deleted first, so bridge ingest_observations rows cannot double-count and no broken history is resumed
